description: 한국전자통신연구원_영장류(붉은털 원숭이) 가상 모델 [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국전자통신연구원. 공개되는 가상 모델 데이터는 전자파 인체 영향 연구를 위한 “복합 전파 환경에서의 국민건강 보호 기반 구축” 사업 수행 결과 중 일부로, 전자파 노출에 대한 가상 시뮬레이션 이외에도 의료 기술 분야에 활용 가능한 범용적 데이터입니다.  구현방법: MRI 영상 및/또는 해부 영상 기반으로 조직 구역화하여... Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국전자통신연구원. Its tags are 정보/통신, 위성/전파, 전자파 진단/방호, 보건의료. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2021-06-16 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
